q: In April 2024, a resolution to recommend admitting Palestine as a full member of the United Nations was vetoed by the United States in the 15-member UN Security Council. How many members of the council either rejected or abstained from voting?
explanation: 12 members voted in favor, 1 against (US veto), and 2 abstained (UK, Switzerland). Thus, a total of 3 members rejected or abstained. (70th BPSC PYQ)

q: Who succeeded Ruchira Kamboj as India's Permanent Representative to the United Nations in New York in September 2024?
explanation: Parvathaneni Harish assumed charge as India's Permanent Representative to the UN on September 1, 2024, succeeding Ruchira Kamboj who retired in June 2024.

q: The Global Gender Gap Report, a frequent subject in BPSC, is released annually by which organization?
explanation: The Global Gender Gap Report is published by the World Economic Forum. (69th BPSC PYQ)

q: What was the theme of the International Olympic Day celebrated on 23rd June 2024?
explanation: The theme of the International Olympic Day 2024 was "Let's Move and Celebrate". (70th BPSC PYQ)

q: Which country became the 32nd member state of NATO in March 2024?
explanation: Sweden officially joined NATO as its 32nd member on March 7, 2024. Finland joined as the 31st member in April 2023.

q: Which country became the 10th full member state of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) at the Astana Summit in July 2024?
explanation: Belarus officially became the 10th member of the SCO on July 4, 2024. Iran was admitted as the 9th member in 2023.

q: Who assumed office as the Secretary General of NATO on October 1, 2024, succeeding Jens Stoltenberg?
explanation: Mark Rutte, the former Prime Minister of the Netherlands, assumed office as NATO Secretary General on October 1, 2024.

q: Who is the current President of the 80th session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA), running from September 2025 to September 2026?
explanation: Annalena Baerbock (Germany) is the President of the 80th session. Dennis Francis headed the 78th session, and Philemon Yang headed the 79th session.

q: Which five countries officially joined BRICS as permanent members on January 1, 2024?
options: Egypt, Argentina, Iran, Saudi Arabia, UAE
Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, UAE
Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa
South Africa, Egypt, Iran, Turkey, Saudi Arabia
explanation: Egypt, Ethiopia, Iran, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE joined BRICS on Jan 1, 2024. Argentina was invited but declined.

q: Who assumed office as the Director General of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) on March 17, 2025?
explanation: Ashish Khanna took charge as the 3rd DG of the ISA on March 17, 2025, succeeding Dr. Ajay Mathur.

q: Which of the following groups of countries were elected as non-permanent members of the UN Security Council for the 2025–2026 term?
options: India, Brazil, Germany, Japan, South Africa
explanation: Denmark, Greece, Pakistan, Panama, and Somalia serve the 2025-2026 term. Bahrain, Colombia, DRC, Latvia, and Liberia serve the 2026-2027 term.

q: In the 2024-2025 period, who serves as the President of the International Court of Justice (ICJ)?
explanation: Nawaf Salam (Lebanon) was elected President of the ICJ in Feb 2024. Julia Sebutinde (Uganda) is the Vice-President.

q: Who is the current Managing Director of the International Monetary Fund (IMF), re-appointed for a second 5-year term starting October 2024?
explanation: Kristalina Georgieva (Bulgaria) was approved for a second 5-year term as MD of the IMF, starting October 1, 2024.

q: The 14th President of the World Bank Group is:
explanation: Ajay Banga (Indian-American) assumed charge as World Bank President on June 2, 2023.

q: Who is the Director-General of the World Trade Organization (WTO), serving a second term starting September 2025?
explanation: Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala of Nigeria began her second 4-year term as WTO DG on September 1, 2025. She is the first woman and first African to lead the WTO.

q: Who is the first Brazilian to be elected as the Secretary General of INTERPOL, taking charge in late 2024?
explanation: Valdecy Urquiza was elected to head INTERPOL, succeeding Germany's Jürgen Stock. He is the first head of INTERPOL from a developing nation.

q: Which organization admitted the African Union as a permanent member during its summit in New Delhi in September 2023?
explanation: The G20 admitted the African Union as a permanent member, effectively turning the group into G21.

q: The President of the New Development Bank (NDB), established by BRICS, is:
explanation: Dilma Rousseff, former President of Brazil, heads the NDB. NDB is headquartered in Shanghai.

q:
Consider the following statements about the UN Security Council:
1. It consists of 15 members, of which 5 are permanent and 10 are non-permanent.
2. Non-permanent members are elected for a term of three years by the General Assembly.
3. Decisions on procedural matters require the affirmative vote of at least 9 members.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Statement 2 is incorrect. Non-permanent members are elected for a term of two years, not three.

q: Who won the Amal Clooney Women's Empowerment Award in May 2024 from King Charles III?
explanation: Arti, an E-rickshaw driver from Uttar Pradesh, was conferred this award for promoting women's safety and mobility. (70th BPSC PYQ)

q: The head of Russia's Wagner Mercenary Group, who died in a plane crash in 2023, was:
explanation: Yevgeny Prigozhin was the head of the Wagner Group. (69th BPSC PYQ)

q: The winner of the prestigious Goldman Environmental Prize 2024 from the region of Asia is:
explanation: Alok Shukla won the prize for his campaign to save the Hasdeo Arand forests in Chhattisgarh, India. (70th BPSC PYQ)

q: Which of the following organizations is headquartered in Manila, Philippines?
explanation: The ADB (headed by Masatsugu Asakawa) is headquartered in Mandaluyong, Manila, Philippines. NDB is in Shanghai, and AIIB is in Beijing.

q: Who was the first female Indian Ambassador to the United Nations, who retired in June 2024?
explanation: Ruchira Kamboj was India's first woman Permanent Representative to the UN. Note: Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit was the first woman President of the UN General Assembly (1953), but Kamboj was the first female PR. (70th BPSC PYQ)

q: Argentina was formally invited to join BRICS at the 2023 Johannesburg Summit. However, it declined the invitation. Who is the current President of Argentina who made this decision?
explanation: President Javier Milei withdrew Argentina from joining BRICS upon taking office, citing shifts in foreign policy.
